items.title: 10.7 Lenz ka qanoon aur induced emf ki simt (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.7 with Figs. 10.15 and 10.16 and Examples 10.6 and 10.7 (PDF 240-243).

blocks.text: Pichhle hisse mein Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon epsilon = -N delta Phi/delta t likha gaya. Is mein manfi alamat bohat aham hai; yeh induced emf ki simt se mutalliq hai. Simt maloom karne ke liye hum us usool ko istemal karte hain jo Russi physicist Heinrich Lenz ki 1834 ki daryaft par mabni hai: induced emf ki polarity hamesha aisa induced current paida karti hai jo magnetic field ki us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne emf banai.

blocks.title: Lenz ka qanoon
blocks.text: Induced current ki simt hamesha aisi hoti hai ke woh us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne current paida kiya.

Lenz ka qanoon khaas taur par induced currents par lagu hota hai, seedhe induced emf par nahi. Is ka matlab hai ke hum ise band conducting loops ya coils par laga sakte hain. Agar loop band na ho to use band farz kar ke induced current ki simt maloom kar sakte hain, aur us se induced emf ki simt.
Bar magnet aur coil ke saath Lenz ka qanoon

Lenz ka qanoon aisi coil par lagayein jis mein bar magnet ki harkat se current induce hota hai. Current wali coil bar magnet jaisi magnetic field banati hai, jis ka ek rukh north pole aur doosra south pole hota hai. Bar magnet ki harkat ki mukhalifat ke liye coil ka magnet ki taraf wala rukh north pole banna chahiye (Fig. 10.15); tab do north poles ek doosre ko dhakelte hain. Right-hand rule ke mutabiq bar magnet ki taraf se dekhne par coil mein induced current anticlockwise hona chahiye. Magnet ka 'dhakka' woh 'tabdeeli' hai jo induced current paida karti hai, aur current dhakke ki mukhalifat karta hai. Doosri taraf agar magnet ko coil se door khainchein to induced current coil ke magnet ki taraf wale rukh par south pole bana kar 'khinchav' ki mukhalifat karta hai.
Lenz ka qanoon aur energy ki baqa

Lenz ka qanoon energy ki baqa ke qanoon ka bhi izhar hai aur induced currents wale circuits par aasani se lagu hota hai. Fig. 10.16 ka tajruba phir dekhein. Jab rod daen taraf chalti hai to us mein emf induce hoti hai, aur loop mein anticlockwise induced current behta hai. Chunke current wali rod magnetic field mein chal rahi hai, us par miqdar ILB sin 90 degrees ki magnetic force Fm lagti hai. Right-hand rule se Fm ki simt velocity v ke ulat hai, to yeh rod ko rokne ki koshish karti hai (Fig. 10.16a). Rod ko mustaqil velocity se chalate rehne ke liye Fm ke barabar magar ulat bairooni force lagani parti hai; yahi bairooni force induced current ke liye zaroori energy deti hai. Yun electromagnetic induction energy ki baqa ke qanoon par poora utarta hai.

Lenz ka qanoon is soorat mein induced current ko clockwise behne se rokta hai, kyunke tab force Fm, v ki simt mein hoti aur rod ko daen taraf tez karti (Fig. 10.16b). Is se zyada taqatwar current induce hota, us ki magnetic force bhi barhti, aur taar ki harkat aur tez hoti jati. Thori si energy se shuru ho kar hum be-had barhti kinetic energy pate, bazahir kahin se nahi; amal khud-ba-khud chalta rehta, jo energy ki baqa ke qanoon ke khilaf hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.6
blocks.text: 25 cm lambi dhaati rod 0.25 T magnetic field ke amudi 0.5 m s^-1 ki speed se chal rahi hai. Rod mein paida hone wali emf nikalein. Hal: v = 0.5 m s^-1, L = 25 cm = 0.25 m, B = 0.25 T = 0.25 N A^-1 m^-1. epsilon = vBL = 0.5 m s^-1 x 0.25 N A^-1 m^-1 x 0.25 m = 3.13 x 10^-2 J C^-1 = 3.13 x 10^-2 V.

blocks.title: Example 10.7
blocks.text: Taar ka ek loop 0.6 T ki yaksan magnetic field mein rakha hai jo loop ki satah ke amudi hai. Loop ka raqba mustaqil sharah delta A/delta t = 0.8 m^2 s^-1 se sukarne lagta hai. Sukarte hue loop mein induced emf ki miqdar kya hai? Hal: N = 1, B = 0.6 T. Flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah = delta phi/delta t = B (delta A/delta t) cos 0 = B delta A/delta t. Faraday ke qanoon se emf ki miqdar epsilon = N delta phi/delta t = N B delta A/delta t = 1 x 0.6 N A^-1 m^-1 x 0.8 m^2 s^-1 = 0.48 J C^-1 = 0.48 V.

blocks.prompt: Bar magnet ek jame hue dhaati chhalle se guzar kar girta hai. Kya woh azaad girte jism ke acceleration se girega (short question 10.5)? Circuit ka switch band karne par coil ke oopar rakha dhaati chhalla uchhalta hai; kyun, aur battery ki polarity ulat dene par kya hoga (constructed response 10.2)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Magnet ke qareeb aane aur door jane par badalta flux chhalle mein aise currents induce karta hai jo Lenz ke qanoon se harkat ki mukhalifat karte hain: chhalla aate magnet ko dhakelta aur jate ko khainchta hai, to woh g se kam acceleration se girta hai. Switch band karne se chhalle se flux achanak barhta hai; chhalle mein induced current use aisa magnet banata hai jo is izafe ki mukhalifat kare, to woh dhakela jata aur uchhalta hai. Battery ulatne se coil ki field aur induced current dono ulat jate hain, to chhalla phir bhi dhakela jata aur uchhalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Resistance nazar-andaz karte hue, kya coil mein mustaqil current us par potential difference bana sakta hai (Point to ponder)? Patriyon par sarakti rod se jure bulb ki istemal ki gayi electrical energy kahan se aati hai (constructed response 10.8)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Mustaqil current mustaqil flux deta hai, to coil mein koi emf induce nahi hoti, aur resistance na hone se IR girawat bhi nahi; koi potential difference nahi. Energy rod ko khainchne wale se aati hai: induced current ki wajah se field rod ko peeche dhakelti hai, aur is rokne wali force ke khilaf kiya gaya kaam bulb mein electrical energy ban jata hai.

items: Lenz (1834): induced current hamesha us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai jis ne use paida kiya; yeh currents par lagu hai (khula loop band farz karein). Andar dhakela magnet qareebi rukh ko N banata hai (dafa; magnet ki taraf se anticlockwise); bahar khinchne par rukh S.

Energy: sarakti rod mein induced current v ke ulat force Fm = ILB deta hai; bairooni force ko kaam karna parta hai jo electrical energy banta hai; clockwise current kuch nahi se energy banata. Misalein: 3.13 x 10^-2 V; 0.48 V.
